title: Rabshakeh's Mockery and Threats Against Jerusalem
description: The king of Assyria sends Tartan, Rab-Saris, and Rabshakeh with a large army from Lachish to Jerusalem. Rabshakeh stands by the aqueduct from the upper pool and speaks loudly in Hebrew so that the people on the wall can hear. He mocks Hezekiah's trust in Egypt and in the Lord, claiming that none of the gods of the nations have been able to save their lands from the king of Assyria. The people remain silent as the king commanded, while Eliakim, Shebna, and Joah go to Hezekiah with torn clothes to report what Rabshakeh has said.
